# sleep-aur 3.1.0

First public release.

A minimalist, auditable AUR helper for Arch Linux.

## Highlights

- Search, install, update, and remove AUR packages
- Resolve repository and recursive AUR dependencies
- Split package support
- JSON package database
- Temporary builds with automatic cleanup
- Persistent build logs with rotation
- Lock file to prevent concurrent runs
- Checksum-verified installation from GitHub releases
- Command-line and interactive shell modes

## Installation

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/the-sleepless/sleep-aur/releases/latest/download/installer.sh -o /tmp/installer.sh
less /tmp/installer.sh
bash /tmp/installer.sh
```

Requires Arch Linux or a derivative with `base-devel`, `git`, `jq`, and `curl`.
